page.overview:
Who is Kenji Kon?

Kenji was born in 2000 to Daniel Kon, the President of Mantah Corp and owns condos in Jurassic World. Kenji, however had a strained and distant relationship with his father, who was barely ever around for him. It is unknown of Kenji's relationship with his mother. When he was 5, drew a picture of himself, his father two women holding hands, and a mermaid off to the side. It is unknown if Kenji's mom and Mr. Kon are divorced, or if Kenji's mom is dead as he claims. While his father's wealth has made Kenji arrogant and entitled, there is a part of him that is not always happy due to his father not spending time with him and giving him the love he needed.

He also mentioned that boys his age teased him a lot for being rich.

Kenji is a guest of Jurassic World, a constant one and considered a VIP due to his rich dad owning the condominiums built on the island and and claims to know the secret passageways under the island. Kenji arrives at Jurassic World in a helicopter and greets the rest of the campers at the docks. One their way to Camp Cretaceous, the truck stops as their counselors Dave and Roxie try to wrangle an escaped Compsognathus that would later appear and startles Kenji and Ben, though the former tries to show off his bravery, the others (save Ben) laughed at him. Later at camp, the counselors tell them about the camp rules they must obey, and later Kenji and the other campers zip-line over a group of herbivorous dinosaurs.

Before going to bed, Kenji confronts Darius, who was sneaking away, boasting about his father's wealth and that he owns condos on the island. He tries to intimidate him, but Brooklynn's intrusion distracts him and together with her decide to join Darius in his efforts to infiltrate what he assumes to be the Compy pen. When they get there, Kenji and Brooklynn fight over her phone, causing it to fall inside the complex. Kenji tries to sneak into the compound to retrieve the phone, despite warnings from Darius. He is almost attacked by the raptor Blue, who is startled and agitated when he takes a photo with the phone's camera. As the raptor stalks him, Darius distracts Blue, while Brooklynn tries to open the door. Delta, Echo, and Charlie join Blue in cornering Darius and Kenji as the episode ends.
